title: ChartNav Workspace — Phase 19J UI
description: A short tour of the redesigned ChartNav clinical workspace: Overview, Clinical / Ophthalmology, Documentation / EMR-EHR, Imaging, and the internal-staff Chat recipient selector. Demo data only.

title: Encounter List to Ready Chart
description: Pick a patient from the encounter rail. Overview opens with the chart already shaped — Patient Snapshot, Visit Summary, Clinical Alerts, Favorites. Recorded against the Phase 19J UI.

title: Workup Flows Into Overview
description: Row-1 cards on Overview carry the technician's prep into the exam before the provider opens the chart. Recorded against the Phase 19J UI.

title: Imaging Tab in the New Workspace
description: Upload, OCT, Fundus, Attachments, Imaging Notes, Selected Image Viewer cards on the Imaging tab. OD/OS retinal workbench sits below. Recorded against the Phase 19J UI.

title: Documentation Tab — Stepper + Workbench
description: Documentation opens with the Transcript → Extracted Facts → AI Draft → Final Note stepper above the embedded NoteWorkspace. Recorded against the Phase 19J UI.

title: From Signed Note to Consult Letter
description: Documentation stepper carries notes from draft to Final Note. Documents tab indexes consult letters, referral PDFs, and reports. Recorded against the Phase 19J UI.

title: Admin Sidebar Group + Visit Status
description: Admin sidebar surfaces Reports + Settings; Overview's Visit Summary card carries the encounter status pill leadership scans. Recorded against the Phase 19J UI.
